messages.content: Is it possible to have a healthy relationship with a big age gap?

Yes, plenty are healthy — the age number itself isn't the deciding factor. What actually matters more is whether both people are at compatible life stages emotionally and practically, and whether there's a real power imbalance being exploited or not.
